lines.text: Walking down the street, catch you in my eye
Heart skips a beat, can’t even say why
Your smile’s like sunshine, melting me away
Got me daydreaming all through the day
Butterflies dancing, feeling so new
Wonder if you notice what I’m going through
Sweet, sweet crush, oh, it’s got me hooked
Like candy on my lips, can’t overlook
You’re the flavor I crave, oh, I crave night and day
Sweet crush, sweet crush, come my way
Notes in my locker, whispers in class
Hoping this feeling will forever last
Eyes meet across the room, spark ignites
Turning ordinary into something right
Pulse is racing, can’t hide the thrill
This emotion’s real, got me standing still
Sweet, sweet crush, oh, it’s got me hooked
Like candy on my lips, can’t overlook
You’re the flavor I crave, oh, I crave night and day
Sweet crush, sweet crush, come my way
Maybe someday you’ll see me too
Turn this dream into something true

Like candy on my lips, can’t overlook
You’re the flavor I crave, oh, I crave night and day
Sweet crush, sweet crush, forever stay
